description.value: A municipal outdoor swimming pool in Princeton, BC, operated by the Town of Princeton as part of its Parks & Recreation facilities. Located right on Highway 3, the pool is a convenient seasonal refreshment stop for cyclists passing through the Similkameen Valley.
